notes.title: Three New Worlds & Discounted Bundle Out Now + ANZ Indie Fest
notes.content: [p]The full Cartoon Survivor experience is here - play through [b]all five worlds[/b] right now![/p][h2]Three New Worlds + Discounted Bundle[/h2][p]We've just launched a huge new update, which includes access to the Stone Age, Mayan, and Ice Age with over 20 new levels.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45578624/ef09269b4c3eff397dcab31e592fd081ced18b9d.png"][/img][/p][p]You can get each of these crazy worlds individually, or pick up the [b]Ultimate Worlds bundle[/b] and [b]get 60% off[/b] the full price. And for everyone who already owns the base game, you'll get an even further discount.[/p][h2]ANZ Indie Fest 2025[/h2][p]We're also proud to share that Cartoon Survivor will be part of the upcoming ANZ Indie Fest 2025 from 5th September - 11th September, celebrating the best indie games from across Australia and New Zealand.[/p][p][b]Check out the showcase here when it goes live:[/b][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/ANZIndieFest2025" style="button"]Explore the ANZ Indie Fest[/url][/p][p]We can't wait to be part of such a great event celebrating so many locally made games! If you want to find out more or chat with our community, please join us on the [url="https://discord.gg/GV3uSkmaxS"]Spunge Games Discord[/url].[/p][p]Thanks for playing![/p]

notes.title: Over 100K Users, New Worlds, and Base Game for $1.99
notes.content: [p]Thanks to everyone for the support over the last few weeks - in just a few days, [b]over 100,000 new players[/b] add the game to their Steam libraries. As of writing this post, we're sitting at [b]160,654 Steam users, [/b]which is absolutely crazy![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45578624/6f2b24839b096db11f91469ba3f1ea089d77efae.png"][/img][/p][h2]New Worlds Coming (Very) Soon[/h2][p]To celebrate this huge milestone, we're introducing a heap of brand new worlds, which you'll be able to play soon. These will be available as individual DLC, or available at a cheaper bundled cost (discounted accordingly for those who own the base game).[/p][p]These new worlds include:[/p][list][*][p][b]Stone Age[/b] - 8 new levels filled with savage sabretooths and caveman chaos![/p][/*][*][p][b]Mayan[/b] - explore ancient civilizations and avoid traps while dashing through stunning temples.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ice Age[/b] - a whole new season awaits! Dodge penguins and seals in 6 cool new levels.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45578624/ef09269b4c3eff397dcab31e592fd081ced18b9d.png"][/img][/p][p]We're aiming to add these new worlds in the next couple of weeks, with an introductory price as a way to thank everyone for all the support. To find out first or chat more about Cartoon Survivor, please join the [url="https://discord.gg/GV3uSkmaxS"]Spunge Games Discord[/url] - it would be great to hear from you![/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/GV3uSkmaxS" style="button"]Join the Spunge Games Discord[/url][/p][p]Hope you all enjoy the new content, and thanks again for playing Cartoon Survivor![/p]

notes.title: Upcoming Changes to Cartoon Survivor
notes.content:
[p]Thanks to everyone who has played Cartoon Survivor so far - we hope you've all been enjoying the cartoon chaos!
We've got some exciting updates to share with the community, which will make purchasing and playing as simple as possible:[/p][h2]Changes to Base Game[/h2][p]Starting next week, from 28th August, the base game of Cartoon Survivor will transition from a free to a paid title. This will also unlock all levels in the game's first two worlds (Jurassic and Prehisteria)[/p][p]If you already have the base game in your library, this means Cartoon Survivor is yours to keep with no payment required. You'll also be able to [b]play all levels in world one and two - that's 15 free levels![/b][/p][h2]Individual Worlds + Cheaper DLC Packs[/h2][p]To make sure players can enjoy as much of the game as possible, we've decided to offer each world as an individual DLC pack at a discounted price. Each world in Cartoon Survivor will be available at a cheaper price, and the full set of all 5 worlds will be available as a bundle at a discount. [/p][h2]Have any Questions?[/h2][p]If you have any questions related to these changes, please don't hesitate to reach out to our team. We are happy to help! You can speak directly with us on the [url="https://discord.gg/GV3uSkmaxS"]Spunge Games Discord Server[/url], or e-mail us at [url="https://marketing@spungegames.com"]marketing@spungegames.com[/url][/p]

notes.title: Cartoon Survivor is out now on Steam!
notes.content: [p]Over 200 million years in the making—[b]Cartoon Survivor is out now on Steam![/b] 🦕 [/p][p]To celebrate, we're offering a limited-time launch discount so you can jump into the first two worlds for 40% off.[/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3800590/Cartoon_Survivor__Jurassic__Prehisteria/" style="button"]Launch Discount - Get 40% Off Worlds 1 & 2[/url][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45578624/74aac6f76f3281520add703d5de28c7184cd566b.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Wild, Colourful Worlds[/b]: Immerse yourself in a bright, cartoonish prehistoric landscape filled with danger, humour, and thrilling obstacles. Think you’ve seen it all? Think again.[/p][p][b]Crazy Obstacles[/b]: Run, leap, and glide through ever-changing environments and wild courses, each one more intense than the last. Can you make it to the end?[/p][p][b]Unique Characters[/b]: Follow in the clumsy, courageous footsteps of the latest cartoon hero. There's over 40 costumes to unlock and creative power-ups to help you along the way![/p][p][b]Dynamic Gameplay[/b]: Put your speed and reflexes to the test! Every run is different, collectable trophies in each level designed to keep you on your toes.[/p][p][/p][p]Be sure to join us on the [url="https://discord.gg/GV3uSkmaxS"][b]Spunge Games Discord[/b][/url] to chat all about the game and find out when new worlds are coming to Cartoon Survivor. We hope you enjoy playing![/p]

notes.title: Cartoon Survivor Launches... TOMORROW!
notes.content: [p]We've waited millions of years for this moment - Cartoon Survivor launches [b]tomorrow[/b] on Steam![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45578624/c1dafa4d8e69a49ec2be1f50ce138155bb02d94b.png"][/img][/p][p]Get ready to run for your life across three free levels and jump into the first two worlds with the [b]Jurassic and Prehisteria DLC pack[/b], available tomorrow.[/p][p]Cartoon Survivor brings vibrant papercraft visuals, chaotic levels filled with obstacles, trophies to collect, and a heap of crazy costumes alongside unlockable power-ups.[/p][p]We can't wait to see what you think as you take control of the last remaining dodo in this ridiculous platforming adventure. To chat with the team about the game or give your feedback, please join the [url="https://discord.gg/GV3uSkmaxS"]Spunge Games Discord[/url] - we'd love to hear from you![/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/GV3uSkmaxS" style="button"]Join the Spunge Games Discord Server[/url][/p][p]Thanks for your support, and we hope you enjoy playing.[/p]
